system.description: Perhaps the foundation of Sanctuary Aeon’s political survival through the ages, this rite acts as a powerful “damper field” preventing any violent or harmful actions. Affecting either a large room or a 10 meter radius around the theurge, any roll made within the Sanctuary using Fight, Melee or Shoot only succeeds on a 1, and any other malevolent or overly aggressive action, such as psychic attack, will be contested by the rite’s roll.
